task: Perform a fresh, independent, read-only final review of the committed BioFabric STEP-03 repaired layout implementation at the supplied commit. Review only these exact target files: crates/core/src/layout/build_data.rs, cluster.rs, control_top.rs, default.rs, hierarchy.rs, link_group.rs, result.rs, set.rs, similarity.rs, and world_bank.rs. Read the fixed public layout traits/types and nearby visible source tests necessary to assess them. The acceptance contract is: fixed APIs/manifests remain unchanged; deterministic valid node rows with no duplicates; regular/shadow columns, spans, grouping and annotations remain coherent; fixed-order extraction behavior remains valid; empty input cannot panic; LayoutParams start-node/mode/link-group behavior is respected; cancellation propagates during material scans; and default, similarity, hierarchy, cluster, control-top, set, and World Bank algorithms implement their advertised modes. In particular, independently check the repaired duplicate control/set handling, parallel DAG arcs, GrayCode least-significant-bit compatibility plus unbounded safety, periodic cancellation in nested scans, true deterministic cluster BFS from inter-cluster adjacency, world-bank hub/spoke grouping, caller link-group-driven column ordering, and preservation of metadata after Between reordering. Cite file:line evidence, consequence, and smallest correction for every confirmed defect; distinguish questions/optional improvements. Do not write source/tests, format, stage, commit, use Docker, run Git, invoke a verifier, or inspect benchmark/results/operator-only paths. You may read source/test text only. Write ONLY RESULT.json. This is a mandatory detailed report: its summary MUST start exactly `REVIEW: SHIP`, `REVIEW: REVISE`, or `REVIEW: BLOCK`; its evidence array MUST contain, verbatim as separate entries, headings `Findings:`, `Contract coverage:`, `Questions:`, and `Verification gaps:` followed by substantive content. A generic outcome without this report is a failed deliverable. ROOT will use your report to accept/reject the source lane.
acceptance_criteria: The review makes no source, test, fixture, manifest, lockfile, workflow, or Git changes; only RESULT.json may be written.

The report independently evaluates exactly the committed target layout files against fixed API, deterministic layout, column/span, extraction, parameter, cancellation, and edge-case contracts, including the listed repair risks.
Every material finding gives file:line evidence, consequence, and smallest correction; questions and optional improvements are clearly separated.
RESULT.json begins with REVIEW: SHIP|REVISE|BLOCK and contains substantive Findings, Contract coverage, Questions, and Verification gaps entries in evidence.
deliverables: A truthful, detailed independent review report in RESULT.json and no other worktree modifications.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: The initial layout review found material defects and ROOT made a focused compatibility correction. A new independent review of the exact repaired custody commit is required before accepting it for downstream work.
